name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 4 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-06-30, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.20 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
